features: Deeply Personalized Home & Explore Feeds: Feeds dynamically adapt to selected Country/Region, multi-language preferences, favorite genres, top artists, and real-time listening history telemetry
Multi-Language Music Fusion: Seamlessly blends regional charts and new releases across all user languages (Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, English, Punjabi) alongside national top hits
Intelligent Quick Picks & Mood Shelves: Time-of-day contextual shelf and Quick Picks interleave tracks from listening history seeds, top artists, and language hits
Personalized Mixes & Tailored Playlists: Supermix, Discover, Chill, and Energy mixes dynamically curate their song selections to match your unique tastes
fixes: Fixed Explore and Home feeds displaying generic Bollywood pop for users with regional language preferences
Fixed Explore screen caching to dynamically invalidate when region, language, or genre preferences change
Fixed guest state insights in offline mode with complete listening history stats
Resolved onboarding preferences test assertions and verified zero analyzer issues
improvements: Unified language, artist, and genre pickers in Settings and Profile with live reactive listeners
Restored 4-step Guided Setup sheet in Profile screen
Optimized network caching and memory footprint for personalized shelf queries
releaseNotes:
• Deeply personalized Home & Explore feeds powered by country, languages, genres, favorite artists & listening history
• Multi-language music fusion across trending charts and new releases
• Dynamic Quick Picks and time-of-day contextual shelves
• Instant reactive preference updates from Settings & Profile
message: Update to v1.1.18 for deeply personalized Home & Explore feeds, multi-language music fusion, and enhanced taste controls
